compatibility.description: ODS version compatibility; used by validate-manifests.sh for version checks

ods_min.description: Minimum ODS version this extension supports (e.g. 2.0.0)

ods_max.description: Maximum ODS version this extension was tested against (optional)

aliases.description: CLI shorthand aliases for this service

container_name.description: Docker container name for ods shell

container_uid.description: Numeric UID the container process runs as when it is not visible from compose.user. Used by the host agent to prepare bind-mounted data directories.

public_url_env.description: Optional env var that contains the public browser URL for this service when served through an external reverse proxy.

host_network.description: True for Docker network_mode: host services that do not declare Docker-mapped ports or HTTP health paths.

socket_only.description: True only for host-systemd services whose HTTP-compatible interface is exposed exclusively over a Unix-domain socket and therefore has no TCP port.

health.description: HTTP health path. Use an empty string for non-HTTP or one-shot services whose readiness is represented by container state/startup_check.

health_auth_env.description: Extension-owned secret environment variable used as a Bearer token for dashboard HTTP readiness. Must start with the upper-case service ID (hyphens replaced by underscores), followed by an underscore, and be declared secret in env_vars. Tokens are resolved at probe time, never embedded in the manifest.

health_source.description: Health authority used by host-side CLI checks. Defaults to http; use container only for internal-only Docker services with a declared Docker healthcheck.

external_link.description: When false, omit this service from dashboard external quicklinks while keeping it in health/status APIs.

docs_url.description: Owner-facing documentation for the application. The dashboard links to it from the extension's guide; when absent, the repository named in the recipe's upstream.json is used.

macos_host_supported.description: True when a host-systemd service has an equivalent macOS LaunchAgent and should remain in the Apple service registry.

startup_check.description: When false, skip the post-install running-state poll and treat compose's clean exit as success. Set this on one-shot CLI / setup-only extensions whose containers intentionally exit (default: true).

startup_timeout.description: Seconds the host agent polls for the container to reach the running state before declaring install failed (default: 15). Increase for extensions with heavy initialization (e.g. JVM, postgres, clickhouse).

compose_file.description: Relative path to compose fragment (e.g. compose.yaml)

category.description: core = always on, recommended = enabled by default, optional = user opts in

depends_on.description: Service IDs this service depends on

format.description: Named value format checked by the dashboard and dashboard-api before the value is saved: hexN = exactly N hexadecimal characters in either case (add a pattern where the service accepts only lowercase); email; url = http(s) URL without credentials; integer = positive whole number without leading zeros.

pattern.description: Anchored regular expression the whole value must match, in addition to format. Must behave identically in Python re and JavaScript RegExp: use explicit classes such as [0-9] (no \d, \w, \b), no \p escapes, and no group opener other than (?: (?= (?!. Requires format_description.

format_description.description: Short owner-facing explanation of pattern, read after "must be" (for example "letters and digits only").

max_length.description: Maximum value length in UTF-8 bytes (for example 72 for bcrypt-hashed passwords).

generate.description: The dashboard may offer a crypto-random value: hexN = N lowercase hexadecimal characters, password = 24 letters and digits, token = 48 letters and digits. The generated value must satisfy format, pattern and lengths.

distinct_from.description: Other settings declared by this manifest that this value must differ from (for example when the service refuses to start with two equal secrets).

env_vars.description: Environment variables used by this service

llm.description: Declares whether and how this service consumes LLM inference so model swaps can be gated and probed.

consumes.description: True when this service sends prompts/completions to an LLM endpoint.

route.description: gateway routes through the ODS model gateway alias; direct talks to a runtime or app-specific endpoint.

pinning.description: none stores no model name; dynamic declares a refresh/reconcile path after swaps.

min_context.description: Optional minimum context length required for this app's LLM path.

probe.description: Harness probe descriptor used after every model swap.

setup_hook.description: Relative path to a setup script run during installation (e.g. setup.sh)

hooks.description: Lifecycle hook scripts. Paths relative to extension directory.

launch.description: Dashboard feature-card launch target. Use type=service for user-facing service UIs, internal for dashboard routes, and none for backend/API-only features.
